headline: S&P Global Ratings Upgrades South Africa Sovereign Credit Rating
summary: S&P Global Ratings has upgraded South Africa’s long-term foreign currency sovereign credit rating to its highest level since 2017, citing fiscal gains.
why: Sovereign credit ratings influence a country's borrowing costs and investor confidence in its government debt.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Improved credit rating reduces borrowing costs and boosts investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Credit rating upgrades generally lead to lower yields on government bonds and increased foreign investment inflows.
